answer: Price each new identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a periodic liveness beacon no wallet can mint in bulk. Standing then climbs a narrow ledge of peer-audited work, each rung co-signed by several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares that root, so its endorsements only ripple back onto themselves and never reach distinct clusters; forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
